metadata.question: Does forest cover in the Madre de Dios region of Peru decrease in 2018 compared to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need forest cover data for Madre de Dios region in Peru for 2013 and 2018. Global Forest Change dataset (Hansen) would be appropriate for forest cover change analysis. 2. Masking strategy: The Hansen dataset already provides forest cover and loss data, so no additional cloud masking needed. 3. Logic: Compare forest cover in 2013 vs 2018. If forest cover in 2018 is less than in 2013, answer A (Yes), else B (No). Need to handle cases where data is missing or invalid. Using Hansen Global Forest Change dataset: - treecover2000: forest cover in 2000 - loss: forest loss pixels (year 2001-2022) - gain: forest gain pixels (2000-2012) For 2013 forest cover: treecover2000 - loss(2001-2013) + gain For 2018 forest cover: treecover2000 - loss(2001-2018) + gain But gain is only for 2000-2012, so for 2018 we can only account for loss up to 2018. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-72.5, -13.0, -68.5, -10.5]); // Madre de Dios region, Peru // 2. Data Acquisition - Hansen Global Forest Change const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2022_v1_10'); // Extract bands const treeCover = hansen.select('treecover2000'); const loss = hansen.select('loss'); const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); const gain = hansen.select('gain'); // Create forest cover for 2013 (treecover2000 minus losses 2001-2013 plus gains) const loss2013 = loss.updateMask(lossYear.lte(13)); // lossyear 1-13 = 2001-2013 const forest2013 = treeCover.updateMask(loss2013.neq(1)).add(gain); // Create forest cover for 2018 (treecover2000 minus losses 2001-2018 plus gains) const loss2018 = loss.updateMask(lossYear.lte(18)); // lossyear 1-18 = 2001-2018 const forest2018 = treeCover.updateMask(loss2018.neq(1)).add(gain); // 3. Calculate forest cover statistics const stats2013 = forest2013.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2018 = forest2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const count2013 = forest2013.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); const count2018 = forest2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); const forest2013_mean = stats2013.get('treecover2000'); const forest2018_mean = stats2018.get('treecover2000'); const count2013_val = count2013.getInfo(); const count2018_val = count2018.getInfo(); // 4. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2013 Forest Cover: ${forest2013_mean.getInfo().toFixed(2)}%, Pixels: ${count2013_val}`); console.log(`2018 Forest Cover: ${forest2018_mean.getInfo().toFixed(2)}%, Pixels: ${count2018_val}`); // Check for valid data if (count2013_val === 0 || count2018_val === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } const cover2013 = forest2013_mean.getInfo(); const cover2018 = forest2018_mean.getInfo(); if (cover2013 === null || cover2018 === null || isNaN(cover2013) || isNaN(cover2018)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (cover2018 < cover2013) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
